Fault logging with contact injection working - POST /api/gym-floor/fault returns reporter {name, email, mobile} and creates issue with created_by_name/email/mobile fields
Staff without email cannot log faults - returns 400 'Your contact details are incomplete — ask the manager to add your email before logging faults.'
Manager Setup UI shows 3 inputs (Name, Email *, Mobile optional) with 'Email is required so the supplier can reach the right person' description
Existing staff without email show '⚠ no email' warning in roster with Edit button to add details
Contact preview text shows 'We'll attach <name>'s contact details to the supplier ticket' when staff selected
Fault success banner shows 'Fault logged · FLT-XXXXXXXX - Reported by <name> (<email>). The supplier will reach out on the contact details above.'
